[[Lizardman]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] after being unlocked at a cost of 75 [[Slayer reward points]] via the ''Reptile got ripped'' ability.

Normal lizardmen come in three forms; a plain level 53 and 62 variant, and the level 75 [[lizardman brute]]. These are simple enemies and have a weak poison that starts at 3 damage. They have very few lucrative drops, so these variants are primarily killed for the sake of speeding through a task with a cannon, often at the [[Lizardman Canyon]] due to it being a [[multicombat area]].

The stronger [[lizardman shaman|shamans]] can be found in more sparse locations, and are more commonly killed as they drop the valuable [[dragon warhammer]], which is popular for players who cannot acquire an [[elder maul]]. Lizardmen shamans require the use of [[Shayzien armour]] in order to kill them, as they have a unique poison spit that can deal up to 30 damage, which is fully blocked while wearing a full set of tier 5 shayzien armour. They also have various mechanics that make them harder to kill, though they are still easily dealt with using a ranged weapon and [[Protect from Missiles]]. 

When killing shamans it is highly recommended to do so at the [[Lizardman Temple]] as the AoE explosion from their [[Spawn (lizardman shaman)|spawns]] are reduced from 5x5 to 3x3 due to the small size of the temple chambers. It is also recommended that players complete the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary#Hard|Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary]] to unlock a toggle from [[Captain Cleive]] that allows the [[Slayer helmet]] to act as a variant of the Shayzien helmet (Note: this requires having access to a [[Shayzien helm (5)]] first.), allowing the bonuses from the Slayer helmet to apply onto the shamans.

Killing any variant of lizardmen while on a normal [[Lizard#Slayer strategy|Lizard]] task will '''NOT''' progress the task.
